verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows n8n providing building blocks (AI Agent nodes, MCP client/trigger, model connectors) for constructing AI-powered workflows, but no documentation of a built-in AI assistant inside the product itself that a user can delegate tasks to (e.g., a chat-based workflow-building copilot). 'What agents do' (n8n-docs-18) describes agent nodes as automation components, not an embedded assistant helping the user operate the product.
